Needs changes before merge.

The kind list now includes all seven machine kinds. The first four indices remain unchanged. The structural test checks each dropdown entry and the visible rows. The decision file explains the scope and alternatives.

Local validation used `.claude/worktrees/review-2061` with its own target directory. The trial merge with `upstream/main` at `31f8d03d744e77ce707282d816e11efe0922f239` reported “Already up to date.” The PR contains that main commit. No GitHub runner was used.

`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` passed:

| Suite | Passed | Ignored | Failed |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| UI library | 848 | 6 | 0 |
| boundary | 3 | 0 | 0 |
| boundary_picks | 6 | 0 | 0 |
| sinker_setup | 2 | 0 | 0 |
| tap_hand | 3 | 0 | 0 |
| theme_files | 14 | 0 | 0 |
| waterjet_tool | 1 | 0 | 0 |

`cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` passed.

Requested before merge:

1. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/machines_pane.rs:62` and the PR body: add before and after screenshots of the Machines pane dropdown. This UI change requires both images. The body currently contains neither image. Store the images only on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch. Link both images from the PR body. Do not add them to the PR branch.

This change does not affect posted G-code, gouge checks, collision checks, stock simulation or geometry. No goldens changed. I did not repeat the author's mutation test. This review does not require safety-tier mutation checks. Pixel snapshots and native window interaction were not run.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

The requested before and after images are now in the PR body.
Both images show the Machines pane with its kind dropdown open.
The images are stored only on the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch.
Image commit: `0854dd03e3e8b43f4a8e9473277cca6c0ed55f0e`.
Both image links return valid PNG files.

Pin: `the_kind_filter_offers_every_machine_kind_and_filters_its_rows`.
The pin failed with the original four kinds and passed after the seven kinds were restored.
All temporary capture edits were removed.

`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` passed: 877 tests passed, six were ignored, and none failed.
`cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` passed.

PR head: `2f17b1ec859726bb0e96f5813a750699850638ea`.
The source head is unchanged because this finding required images and a PR body update only.
The plain push reported that the branch was up to date.

Please review this PR again.
